name: Spritz & Co - WET Tax Automation
description: Automate wine tax calculations and order processing for Spritz & Co. Integrates Shopify orders with tax computation (WET + GST), Xero invoicing, and Airtable data persistence. Processes Shopify webhook events to classify customers (wholesale/retail), calculate taxes, manage Xero contacts/groups, create invoices, and store complete audit trail.

inputs.code: const order = trigger.body; if (!order.id || !order.line_items) { throw new Error('Invalid Shopify webhook: missing order data'); } return { orderId: order.id, customerEmail: order.email || order.customer?.email, customerName: order.customer ? `${order.customer.first_name} ${order.customer.last_name}`.trim() : 'Unknown', lineItems: order.line_items.map(item => ({ productId: item.product_id, title: item.title, quantity: item.quantity, price: parseFloat(item.price) })) };

const customerId = trigger.body.customer?.id; const isWholesale = Array.isArray(wholesaleCustomers) && wholesaleCustomers.some(c => c.id === `gid://shopify/Customer/${customerId}`); return { customerId, isWholesale, customerType: isWholesale ? 'Wholesale' : 'Retail' };

const wholesaleWetRate = 0.29; const retailWetRate = 0.145; const gstRate = 0.1; const wetRate = customerClassification.isWholesale ? wholesaleWetRate : retailWetRate; return orderData.lineItems.map((item, idx) => { const basePrice = item.price; const wetAmount = basePrice * wetRate; const subtotal = basePrice + wetAmount; const gstAmount = subtotal * gstRate; const total = subtotal + gstAmount; return { ...item, basePrice, wetRate, wetAmount: parseFloat(wetAmount.toFixed(2)), gstAmount: parseFloat(gstAmount.toFixed(2)), totalPrice: parseFloat(total.toFixed(2)), xeroTaxCode: 'TAX001' }; });

const names = orderData.customerName.split(' '); const firstName = names[0]; const lastName = names.slice(1).join(' ') || ''; return { Name: orderData.customerName, FirstName: firstName, LastName: lastName, EmailAddress: orderData.customerEmail };

const groupName = customerClassification.isWholesale ? 'Wholesale Customers' : 'Retail Customers'; let targetGroup = contactGroups.find(g => g.Name === groupName); return { needsGroupCreation: !targetGroup, groupName, groupId: targetGroup?.ContactGroupID };
const groupId = groupOps.groupId || newContactGroup?.ContactGroupID; if (!groupId) throw new Error('Failed to resolve contact group ID'); return { groupId };
return taxCalculations.map(item => ({ Description: `${item.title} (x${item.quantity})`, Quantity: item.quantity, UnitAmount: item.basePrice, AccountCode: '200', TaxType: item.xeroTaxCode }));

return { Name: orderData.customerName, Email: orderData.customerEmail, 'Customer Type': customerClassification.customerType, 'Xero Contact ID': xeroContact.ContactID, 'Last Updated': new Date().toISOString() };
const customerId = airtableCustomer?.id || newCustomerRecord?.id; if (!customerId) throw new Error('Failed to create/find Airtable customer'); return { customerId };

return taxCalculations.map(item => ({ 'Product': item.title, 'Quantity': item.quantity, 'Unit Price': item.basePrice, 'WET Amount': item.wetAmount, 'GST Amount': item.gstAmount, 'Total Price': item.totalPrice, 'Tax Type': item.xeroTaxCode, 'Order': [airtableOrder.id] }));

const totalAmount = taxCalculations.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.totalPrice * item.quantity, 0); return { success: true, shopifyOrderId: orderData.orderId, customerEmail: orderData.customerEmail, customerName: orderData.customerName, customerType: customerClassification.customerType, xeroContactId: xeroContact.ContactID, xeroInvoiceId: xeroInvoice.InvoiceID, airtableOrderId: airtableOrder.id, lineItemCount: taxCalculations.length, totalAmount: parseFloat(totalAmount.toFixed(2)), timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), message: `Successfully processed ${orderData.customerName}'s order with WET and GST calculations` };
